plan.title: 3' tag-seq DE: treated vs control liver, DESeq2 + GSEA
plan.analytical_narrative: The dataset is a 3-vs-3 unpaired bulk RNA-seq comparison (drug-treated vs control liver, human, 12000 genes x 6 samples) from a Lexogen QuantSeq 3' tag-seq library quantified with STAR/featureCounts into raw integer gene counts. Because this is a 3' tag protocol, gene counts do not scale with transcript length, so no length-based normalization (TPM/FPKM, tximport) is applied — raw counts go directly into DESeq2, which handles library-size normalization internally via median-of-ratios size factors. The plan follows the grounded procedure from the knowledge service end to end: (1) sample-structure QC via blind VST, PCA, and sample-distance heatmap to confirm treated/control separate and no outlier sample dominates before any test is fit; (2) a minimal low-count pre-filter tuned down for 3' tag data (>=5 counts in >=3 samples, the smallest group size) since a full-length-library floor of 10 would disproportionately remove long genes under-sampled by 3' tag counting; (3) DESeq2 with an explicit reference level (control) and design ~condition, fit with the Wald test; (4) apeglm shrinkage of the log2 fold changes for reporting and ranking; (5) BH-adjusted significance at alpha=0.05 with independent filtering, reporting the p-value histogram as a fit diagnostic; (6) preranked GSEA (fgsea) on the full ranked gene list (ranked by the Wald statistic, not fold change alone) against MSigDB Hallmark and Reactome gene sets available in the environment, since 3 vs 3 replication gives low power for single-gene calls and a coordinated pathway-level shift may be detectable even when individual genes are not significant; (7) a consolidated report stating the explicit power caveat for n=3 per group, fit diagnostics (MA plot, dispersion plot), the reproducibility record, and — because a full gene list plus pathway hits is directly relevant to a drug-treatment study — a lightweight mapping of any significant genes/pathways to known drug targets to ground interpretation rather than let it speculate about mechanism.

steps.method: vst(blind) PCA, sample distance heatmap, library size barplot
Low count filter: keep gene with >=5 counts in >= smallest group size (3) samples
DESeq2 design ~condition, explicit reference level = control, raw counts no length correction
fgsea preranked GSEA on Wald statistic, MSigDB Hallmark then Reactome
DE + enrichment report with QC, MA/dispersion plots, power caveat, reproducibility record
